title: Digital-arrest fraud on Prof. Suresh Kulkarni (Rs 38.5 lakh)
story: Between 03 and 05 Oct 2026 a caller posing as a courier company and then a 'CBI officer Vikram Rathore' kept the victim on a video call ('digital arrest') and made him transfer Rs 38.5 lakh in three RTGS transfers to Rohit Pawar's Konkan SFB account. Rohit had rented his account to Imran Shaikh for Rs 15,000 and forwarded each OTP to the scam number 8969204117. Money was layered to Imran (Rs 21.4 L) and two other accounts. Imran withdrew cash at the Dwarka Circle ATM in Nashik. The scam numbers were operated by Sameer Ansari from Nashik: the handset IMEI 356938112847152 carried his personal SIM 9765330812 before and after the scam window and the scam SIM 8969204117 during it.

roles.Vikram Rathore: fake identity used by Sameer Ansari
roles.Ramesh Yadav: fake KYC name on scam SIM 8969204117
roles.Pooja Verma: fake KYC name on scam SIM 7303518246
